subject: general
question: In the given main characteristics of farming of India, which is the characteristic of primitive subsistence farming?
solution:
The correct option is __**Slash and Burn.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Primitive Subsistence Farming** is a type of farming which is practiced on small patches of land with the help of primitive tools.
 
• Its also known as **Slash and Burn farming**.
 
• The **main crops are Banana, Beans, Millets, Corn, Yams etc**.
 
• Tools like digging sticks, hoe and dao are used in this type of farming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of agriculture in India:**

 
 
• Commercial farming
 
• Plantation agriculture
 
• Subsistence agriculture
 
• Shifting agriculture
 
• Extensive farming
 
• Terrace agriculture
 
• Intensive farming
 
• Wetland farming
 
• Dry Land farming
